name: surat-textile-dashboard-root
description: Root package.json for Surat Textile Intelligence Dashboard

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix src/backend" "npm run dev --prefix src/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix src/backend && npm run build --prefix src/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix src/backend && npm run test --prefix src/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix src/backend && npm run lint --prefix src/frontend
